english.title: Trade in apes other than between approved centres

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: trade in animals and related products regulations 2011

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) traded in apes, namely **(..SPECIFY THE SPECIES..), other than between a centre approved by the Secretary of State and a centre approved by the competent authority for the other member State, namely **(..SPECIFY THE OTHER MEMBER STATE INVOLVED IN THE TRADE..), in accordance with Article 5 of Council Directive 92/65/EEC ("the Balai Directive")
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 5(1) of Schedule 2 to and regulations 39 and 42(2) of the Trade in Animals and Related Products Regulations 2011.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum
Indictment: A fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
